method.source: TradingView OANDA:XAUUSD, archived OHLC merged with latest fetched completed candles
method.training: August 3 through September 30, 2026; training outcomes truncated at October 1 00:00 UTC
method.validation: October 1 through November 18 02:00 UTC, 2026; no training setups carried into validation
method.candidates: 165 pairs. First entry 0–50%, second entry greater than first through 100%, both in 5-percentage-point increments. Percent of confirmation body measured from original reference. 0% means reference entry.
method.unchanged: Original fixed SL/TP, BUY lower and SELL higher, 60/40 total-risk allocation, 75-minute entry window, archived qualifying signals, 300-pip per-leg maximum. Invalid entries beyond SL are skipped; unused risk is not transferred in ideal sizing.
method.selection: Before grid results: at least 70 resolved training setups (70% of baseline), at least 112 training setups with both geometrically valid entries (90% of available setups). Profit winner maximizes certain-result net R. Win winner maximizes setup win rate. Balanced score averages training percentile rank for conservative lower-bound net R and win rate.
method.counting: One signal is one setup. TP/SL needs at least one definitely filled leg and no uncertain leg outcome. Percentages exclude uncertain/open/unfilled/no-entry setups. Whole uncertain/open setups excluded from main dollar totals. Also report loose pessimistic/optimistic R bounds for unresolved OHLC paths.
method.dollars: Illustrative $200 capital, fixed $4 setup risk, no compounding. Ideal fractional lots; no spreads, fees, slippage, margin, daily-loss limits, concurrent-trade caps or half-risk overlap adjustments. Cash is gross research P&L, not executable account returns.
method.minimumLotSensitivity: Separate sizing-only sensitivity uses current Exness XAUUSDm contract 100 oz, .01 minimum/step, fixed $4 budget. If either split lot is too small, skip first and try second with full budget, rounded down. Not a broker replay: bid/ask, tick rounding, commissions, margin and account-level controls are not modeled.
method.limits: Exploratory historical tuning on one instrument and 235 archived qualified setups. Later-period validation is a chronological check, not pristine independent unseen data: the baseline was already reviewed. Many parameter comparisons increase selection bias. No future performance guarantee or live strategy change.
